I replied to Marcus in his thread in #north-team, but couldn't give him one settled date because the records don't agree:

- **25 November:** Ilse's 14 Oct post in #north-team.
- **30 November 2026:** the signed 2025–26 renewal order form and the Brackenwater account page.
- **31 December 2026:** a CRM note from Feb 2026, which doesn't match the contract.

I found no signed change moving the date to 25 November. I suggested he check with Ilse before updating the account sheet.

I only used sources Marcus can see: he's in #north-team, and he owns the Brackenwater account. I didn't include any prices or other money terms from the contract.

My 14 Oct reply to Ilse noted 25 November without checking it against the contract. Also, my end-of-turn summary from that request now appears as its own message in #north-team (ts …000125), and it repeats that unchecked date.
